constitutionalLaws: LAW-071: drift evidence integrity — assessment always requires evidenceRef
LAW-099: recommendation-not-command — no execution methods on recommendations
LAW-100: windows required — observation window mandatory for all drift assessment
LAW-101: uncertainty disclosure — missing/unavailable provider yields INCONCLUSIVE, not NO_DRIFT
LAW-102: retraining admission separation — cross-stage request, never direct execution
LAW-103: retirement integrity — retirement blocked by ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT/ACTIVE_CONSUMER/LEGAL_HOLD/RETENTION_POLICY
LAW-104: operations evidence completeness — no assessment without evidenceRef
LAW-105: no silent production mutation — rollback/traffic/training requests only, no direct action
LAW-106: contradiction does not fabricate certainty — mixed signals resolve CONTRADICTORY
LAW-107: confidence bounded — confidence must be finite in [0,1]
